<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:NAME -->
# vncuseradd
add new LOGIN(s) with VNC capabilities
<!-- END GENERATED:NAME -->

## Synopsis

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:SYNOPSIS -->
```
vncuseradd [OPTION]... LOGIN [LOGIN]...
```
<!-- END GENERATED:SYNOPSIS -->

* needs TigerVNC Server installed with config at `/etc/tigervnc/vncserver.users`
* random passwords are generated and printed to stdout (system password is expired on first login; rotate VNC password with `vncpasswd`)

Run `vncuseradd -h` for a quick reference, or `man vncuseradd` once installed for full details.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:OPTIONS -->
```
  -a            make the LOGIN(s) an admin account (adds user(s) to wheel
                group)
  -o FILE       also write generated credentials to FILE (created with mode
                0600). Without this flag, credentials are printed to stdout
                only.
  -h            Display the help message.
  -s            Starts the VNC service(s) now (otherwise reboot or start
                manually)
  -v            Turn on debug mode.
  -V            Display version.
```
<!-- END GENERATED:OPTIONS -->
